title: Four gliding beings in uniforms beside the truck
summary: Mario Woods tells of Four gliding beings in uniforms beside the truck, about 1977 at November-5 launch facility, near Nisland, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: November-5 launch facility, near Nisland, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I turn my head and I see these four I'm going to call them beings and they are not walking as you and I walk they are just gliding across the ground
And as they approached me, there was three small ones and one tall one in the back.
tellings.difference: Says three were small and one tall one was at the back.
tellings.link_reason: The same four gliding beings coming toward the truck at November 5.

as_told.title: Four gliding beings come toward the truck
as_told.place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

plain: Mario Woods, who says he was an Air Force guard at nuclear missile sites, tells of a night in 1977 at a missile launch site called November-5 near Nisland, South Dakota. He says he turned his head and saw four beings in uniforms beside his truck, not walking but gliding across the ground. In a later telling he says three of them were small and one tall one stayed at the back, and if true it would mean non-human beings came right up to a nuclear weapons site.
